text: So that's the journey through the iPhone Duo. You open it, and a hinge with more than a hundred parts turns, held in step by gears and springs.
The screen bends into a gentle loop, its organic LEDs shining through color filters and a soft polymer cover.
Power flows from two batteries, one charging across the fold, to billions of nanosheet transistors in the A20 Pro, while heat travels the other way, through a graphite pipe in the hinge.
All of it, in a phone five point two millimeters thick.
If you enjoyed this journey inside the iPhone Duo, subscribe, and we'll take apart something new next time.
